Scientific_Justification: Standard asymptotic approximation for fast ice streams and shelves (MacAyeal 1989; Pattyn et al. 2008). Validated in MISMIP+.
Limiting_Assumptions: Requires small aspect ratio epsilon = H/L << 1 and small surface slope delta = |grad s| <= 0.10 rad (~5.71 deg). Formally invalid on steep alpine cliffs.
Verification_Evidence: MISMIP+ benchmark pass; ISMIP-HOM Experiment B pass; Physical Applicability Gate formalizes domain of validity.

Design_Choice_Identifier: DEC-02: Zero Floating Basal Traction Baseline (tau_b^f = 0.0 Pa)
Scientific_Justification: Sub-shelf ocean drag tau_ocean = -rho_w*C_d*|u - u_w|*(u - u_w) is < 1e-5 Pa at typical ice speeds, which is 6-10 orders of magnitude smaller than grounded basal traction (10^4-10^5 Pa).
Limiting_Assumptions: Neglects turbulent sub-shelf ocean boundary layer drag. Physically justified as unconstrained without 3D ocean model.
Verification_Evidence: Dimensional verification [kg/(m*s2) = Pa]; order-of-magnitude analysis in Table 1; retained as documented sensitivity option.

Design_Choice_Identifier: DEC-03: Extreme-Slope Physical Applicability Gate & Decoupling
Scientific_Justification: Decouples Newton-Krylov algebraic convergence from physical model validity. Asymptotic expansion breaks down when delta^2 = |grad s|^2 is not << 1. At Row 1774 (38.98 deg, delta = 0.809), delta^2 = 0.655 >> 0.01.
Limiting_Assumptions: 2D SSA is treated as Level B planview approximation on slopes > 5.71 deg. Prohibits Gaussian smoothing as physics substitute.
Verification_Evidence: Mandates 2D vertical Blatter-Pattyn / Full-Stokes cross-section evaluation for Row 1774 transect. Raw (3,586 kPa) and trigonometric (2,788 kPa) preserved.

Design_Choice_Identifier: DEC-04: WGS84 Ellipsoidal Area Weighting (A_true = dx*dy / k^2)
Scientific_Justification: Snyder (1987) conformal projection geometry. Corrects 100% of polar stereographic volume distortion (+653.31 km3 delta explained to 0.0035 km3).
Verification_Evidence: Phase 2.6 and Stage 4.3.1.2 mathematical proof (0.0000% volume error).

Limiting_Assumptions: Homogenizes ice thickness across 1 km cell. Jagged boundary cells require cut-cell verification.
Verification_Evidence: Proved 0.0000% volume conservation error; Table 4 cut-cell analysis identifies required benchmark tests.

Design_Choice_Identifier: DEC-06: 6-Part Synthetic Dynamic Conservation Test Suite
Scientific_Justification: Rigorous analytical formulation of TEST-1 to TEST-6: internal face cancellation (< 1e-15), 2-to-1 AMR metric matching (< 1e-14 kg/s), cut-cell boundary fluxes, moving GL mass preservation, single-metric invariance, and closed Leibniz VAF budget (< 1e-6).
Limiting_Assumptions: Tests represent rigorous theoretical specifications designed for implementation and execution in Stage 4.5.
Verification_Evidence: Complete mathematical derivations provided in Table 3; moving GL transport integral proven to vanish identically in VAF continuity equation.

Design_Choice_Identifier: DEC-07: Post-Collapse Crane Glacier Basal Traction Inversion
Scientific_Justification: Crane Glacier accelerated 300-800% after Larsen B collapse (2002). Inverting C_bed using BedMachine post-collapse geometry requires post-collapse velocity.
Limiting_Assumptions: Basal hydrology and effective pressure may have changed post-collapse.
Verification_Evidence: Requires dedicated inversion audit in Stage 4.5. Frozen Ryder calibration remains unchanged.

Design_Choice_Identifier: DEC-08: Theoretical Host Computational Scaling Projections
Scientific_Justification: Estimated from sparse matrix sparsity bandwidth (25 nonzeros/row) and empirical MUMPS fill-in factors (5-10x nonzeros).
Limiting_Assumptions: Assumes standard compact 9-point finite difference/volume stencil without fill-in bloat.
Verification_Evidence: Must be measured directly on host hardware during Stage 4.5 benchmarking.
